WITH team_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    SUM(games) as total_games
  FROM home_game
  GROUP BY team_id
),
with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    total_games,
    SUM(total_games) OVER () as grand_total,
    AVG(total_games) OVER () as avg_total
  FROM team_totals
)
SELECT 
  team_id,
  total_games,
  CAST(total_games AS FLOAT) / grand_total as fraction_of_total,
  CAST(total_games AS FLOAT) / avg_total as ratio_to_average
FROM with_stats
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
